# Stefan Manja

> Internal AI systems for enterprise and mid-market workflows. Stefan Manja builds and hardens systems that need disciplined evaluation, cost and usage visibility, reliable deployment, and real-world usefulness.

Based in Belgrade, Serbia (Europe/Belgrade, CET/CEST). Engagements are project-scoped for enterprise and mid-market teams; default to in-person or hybrid in Belgrade, remote across Europe otherwise.

Stack includes Python, Flask, Docker, PostgreSQL, pgvector, LangChain, Azure AD SSO, LLM APIs, and workflow automation for enterprise environments.

Public proof points (anonymized where required):
- ~75% reduction in credit-risk analysis time (Delta Holding)
- 90%+ recommendation acceptance rate from analysts
- 4.4/5 analyst-rated quality on credit-risk decision-support workflow
- 50+ AI workflows assessed across opportunity framing, PoCs, and first scaled rollout
- Self-hosted internal assistant deployed to ~1,500 eligible users (300+ actual, 85%+ positive feedback after launch)
